deliberation: The exact candidate now speaks clearly about its central restraint: a factor-0.1 deadline transform does not compress evidence, review, protection, authority, or mathematical truth; blockers and bounded negative results remain lawful outputs; and Council advice, automation, merge, protected readback, production authority, and MATHCERT certification are not treated as synonyms. Its human-action model also correctly reserves the substantive exact-packet Human Steward act while removing reassurance-driven routine routing. The candidate is nevertheless not semantically closed enough to activate. Plan activation is described once as following Human Steward disposition and protected merge, elsewhere as arising only from successful protected-main activation readback, while the receipt schema permits T0 to be unrelated to readback. The plan window excludes T0 + P9D although the terminal packet is due at that endpoint. The ledger says it has states only, but gates also use pass, complete, blocker, terminal record, protected, disposition, continuation, and retirement without a typed relation among them; HWM calls PENDING terminal. The EXT workstream alternates among independent agent exercise, outside user, non-institutional user, outside group, external value, useful adoption, and external exercise, allowing an internal non-author agent test to be narrated as external use or adoption. The word factor-0.1 itself denotes both the active maintenance acceleration and this proposal's distinct schedule-compression factor. Protected, activation, review, sponsor, owner, and disposition are similarly overloaded across administrative, visual, mathematical, Council, and Human Steward interfaces. These are not cosmetic defects: different conforming agents can start the clock, close gates, classify evidence, route humans, and state external or mathematical outcomes differently. Repair requires governed byte changes, explicit namespaced vocabularies, and fresh exact-candidate review, so interpretive conditions cannot cure this head.
discharged_obligations: Mapped the normative vocabulary across the Council matter and proposal, exact plan, transform manifest, activation receipt schema, Constitution, active authority schedule, and Human Steward directive.

Distinguished Human Steward authorization, Council advice, office review, ordinary merge execution, protected integration, activation readback, routine operation, later reserved action, and mathematical certification.
Compared every plan-state, gate-state, occurrence-state, HWM-state, workstream-outcome, terminal recommendation, and Council-decision term for stable scope, terminality, and interface meaning.
Tested whether external, independent, outside, sponsor, user, reproducer, adoption, publication, product, and commercial terms preserve the plan's stated claim boundaries.
Verified the exact candidate artifact identities, ran the canonical validator and seven focused tests, and assessed semantic claims that remain unenforced despite those passing checks.
findings: The active matter binds canonical digest 90506de300daf50c96dd57eb6eeb01616b298dd454689c562ab6a56c17614504 and proposal SHA-256 f92a71f49d17d6848c10ecfc5310f859ec8fad1fe946eb413f5f46cf69218620.

At exact MATH-PROGRAMME head 4abe7653e74a3a1fd16e8b9e72e5c61646718241, the plan is blob 8d1f06567acc40f196a0952bdbce0ee4cbc84c21 with SHA-256 e929e5f0fac363423ae8c1ea8ae84f0859a4103d8f9e01c3485f5e4e65ad9843, the transform is blob 012b3ef62d14b51b3d4f08c5c565024a0356e674 with SHA-256 24540e704c441780fec0dc5f59eee413a1e9b500455479d967f0a9ae19534086, and the activation schema is blob ffc3b607f94679b722b5268157c3b83b6226e518. The canonical validator and all seven focused tests pass.

The plan's Status line says it activates only after the reserved Human Steward disposition and protected merge. Section 2.1 and the Council proposal instead require successful protected-main activation readback after merge, and state that merge is not T0. The shorter status sentence omits the event that actually distinguishes merged-but-inactive from active.

The activation schema gives t0_utc and readback_completed_at_utc the same syntactic type but no semantic relation. It also does not constrain plan_candidate_head, plan and transform digests, Council matter digest, or nested Human Steward bindings to the exact identities named by this packet. The interface can therefore label an unrelated or retrospective timestamp T0 while remaining schema-valid.

The plan window is the half-open interval [T0, T0 + P9D), but the transform places terminal_packet at T0 + P9D and the plan repeatedly says it is due by that instant. Without a boundary rule, the terminal packet is simultaneously required to close the plan and excluded from the interval in which the plan is active.

OPS-01 declares nine ledger states only and includes neither COMPLETE nor PASS, while OPS-B prohibits marking an item complete without defining that predicate. Phase exits require gates to pass or carry blockers, Gate E requires a disposition, several workstreams require terminal records, and the terminal packet recommends actions. No namespaced type says which terms are ledger states, gate dispositions, evidence conditions, or plan dispositions, or how one maps to another.

HWM-01 introduces PROCESSED, VERIFIED_NOOP, PENDING, FAILED, and SUPERSEDED_BY_REPLAY under the singular label terminal state. PENDING ordinarily denotes nonterminal work, FAILED may be either retryable or terminal elsewhere in the plan, and SUPERSEDED_BY_REPLAY does not say whether the original transition or the replay owns the durable claim. The undefined meanings directly affect checkpoint advancement.

The proposal and plan use disposition for at least three different acts: advisory Council compilation followed by Human Steward disposition, ADM-03 reliability classification, and terminal per-workstream recommendations. They also use activation for both plan activation and a visual live switch, review for Council, office, Referee, mathematical, operating, and semantic processes, and protected for branch integration and an untyped ledger state. These terms require explicit qualifiers in records and UI surfaces.

The maintenance contract already uses acceleration_factor 0.1 for the active steady-state regime, while this proposal uses factor 0.1 for the P90D-to-P9D schedule transform. Phrases such as factor-0.1 maintenance regime and factor-0.1 evidence window collapse two separately governed quantities and can cause an operator to infer that changing one changes the other.

EXT-B expressly permits an independent agent outside the original authoring path. Elsewhere EXT requires a specific outside user or reproducer, accessibility to a non-institutional user, infrastructure an outside group will actually use, and records useful adoption. An internal non-author agent can establish bounded independent reproducibility, but it cannot by that fact establish external human or organizational use, useful adoption, market evidence, or an outside commitment.

The EXT accountable sponsor may be an authorized agent, but authorized is not bound to an authority source and sponsor conventionally suggests power to make an outside commitment. The plan's nonclaims preserve the legal boundary in prose, yet the role name and Gate EXT-A record can communicate a stronger external relationship than an agent is empowered to create.

Phase 2 requires CMDG-B and OZ-B to pass or carry explicit blockers, but integrated Gate C asks for one CMDG/OZ exact result. The slash leaves AND versus OR unresolved and does not say whether a blocker packet is the exact result counted by Gate C. Two agents can therefore reach different Gate C dispositions from identical evidence.

The plan correctly says roles must not be inferred from automation identity and repeatedly requires non-author or independent review, but it defines no record-level meanings for authoring path, non-author, independent actor, distinct session, accountable owner, or authorized sponsor. The active Council and Steward contracts require separations that cannot be communicated safely by self-selected role labels alone.

Retire is used for duplicate trackers, stale branches, redundant workflows, and reports, and also as a terminal recommendation. The Constitution distinguishes recoverable governed disposal from deletion and protected-rule changes. Without an explicit recoverable archival meaning, the same verb can be read as harmless attention management or as destructive disposal requiring Human Steward authority.

The candidate's strongest claim boundaries are semantically sound: mathematical reductions and bounded computations do not become CM4 or T3, a visual is not evidence, PRVSR is advisory, a deadline is not truth, an exercise is not publication or product authority, and Council concurrence does not activate. Those nonclaims must be preserved unchanged through repair.
conditions: Publish one versioned normative lexicon and machine-readable operating schema. Namespace and define plan_activation, protected_integration, protected_main_readback, visual_live_switch, Council advisory disposition, Human Steward authorization, mathematical disposition, workstream disposition, gate disposition, evidence state, and terminal plan disposition; prohibit unqualified activation, protected, review, complete, pass, terminal, and disposition in interfaces where more than one meaning is possible.

Make the activation sequence text and receipt verifier express one meaning: merged is not active; T0 is exactly the canonical successful protected-main readback completion event after the authenticated approving exact-packet Human Steward disposition, exact-head checks, independent review, and ordinary protected merge. Bind every candidate, plan, transform, Council, nested Steward, repository, branch, merge, readback-head, and byte identity and reject unequal, retrospective, replayed, or conflicting receipts.

Define typed status vocabularies and explicit mappings among OPS ledger states, gate dispositions, evidence conditions, HWM transition states, occurrence cutoff states, workstream outcomes, and plan-level terminal dispositions. Remove COMPLETE and PASS unless they become defined values; classify PENDING as nonterminal; say whether FAILED is retryable; and define the evidence and supersession semantics of SUPERSEDED_BY_REPLAY.

Resolve the endpoint semantics by defining the phase intervals and whether T0 + P9D is an inclusive completion deadline, an out-of-window closure event under a named successor rule, or part of a differently bounded plan interval. Use the same rule in plan prose, transform, terminal contract, and validator.

Separate maintenance_acceleration_factor from operating_schedule_compression_factor in every field and sentence. Preserve their independent authority, source, cadence, and change controls, and do not use factor-0.1 without the qualified object it modifies.

Rename or split the EXT evidence classes so an independent non-author agent exercise proves only bounded reproducibility or usability outside the authoring path. Reserve external human use, external organizational use, adoption, outside-group use, market evidence, and external commitment for records that identify and authenticate the corresponding external actor and authority. If an agent alone may satisfy the required gate, do not label that gate proof of external value or adoption.

Define accountable owner, sponsor, independent actor, non-author, original authoring path, reviewer, and distinct session in a role-attestation interface bound to stable identities and artifact digests. Replace authorized sponsor with a term that does not imply external-commitment authority unless the exact authority source is recorded.

Give every phase and integrated milestone a deterministic typed gate expression. State explicitly whether Gate C requires both CMDG and OZ dispositions or either one, whether a scoped blocker counts as an exact result, how OPS-B participates in phase progression, and which durable evidence converts a blocker-bearing gate into a terminal rather than successful disposition.

Define routine retirement as recoverable archival or supersession with preserved provenance, target identity, recovery path, and protected-rule exclusion. Use deletion, protected-workflow change, and irreversible disposal only for separately named actions with the constitutionally required Human Steward authority.

Retable all semantic and contract repairs as a new exact MATH-PROGRAMME candidate and a newly digested Council matter for fresh independent office review. Preserve the present candidate's authority, mathematical, publication, production, visual-evidence, and commercial nonclaims without weakening or silently renaming them.
residual_uncertainty: A closed vocabulary cannot establish whether the future P9D execution is feasible, whether any maintenance occurrences fall in the anchored observation interval, or whether an independent exercise yields value; those remain future evidence questions.

The exact externality boundary can vary by actor and organization. A machine agent may be independent from the authoring session while remaining institutionally internal, so both dimensions must be recorded rather than inferred from one label.
Some workstream-specific vocabularies may remain distinct, but their namespace, conversion to common gate dispositions, and claim effect must be explicit before aggregation.

Even after semantic repair, protected integration, activation, operational success, mathematical admission, MATHCERT certification, publication, adoption, deployment, revenue, and commercial readiness remain separate states requiring their own evidence and authority.

Future protected heads, required-check state, authenticated Human Steward choice, merge identity, readback event, T0, office staffing, and terminal evidence do not yet exist and cannot be supplied by this review.
